name: nova-prox01
summary: The virtual data centre that runs Nova Corp's firewall, servers and test workstation.

details.label: Platform
details.value: Proxmox VE 9.2.2, nested inside VMware Workstation

details.label: Virtual machines
details.value: 6 configured; 5 running, 1 stopped at last review

details.label: Backup archives
details.value: 6 in the documented storage repository (4 pfSense, 2 DC01)

details.label: Boundary
details.value: Nested lab shares the outer host's physical failure domain

limitations: Backup archive presence does not establish successful whole-VM restoration.
This is a documented snapshot, not live telemetry.

name: nova-fw01
summary: Routes and filters connections between workstations, servers and remote access.

details.label: Platform
details.value: pfSense CE 2.8.1, VM 100

details.label: Network segmentation
details.value: Five VLANs; WireGuard is a tunnel, not a sixth VLAN

details.label: Firewall configuration
details.value: 17 recorded filter rules (13 pass, 4 block)

details.label: Security boundary
details.value: Dedicated privileged management isolation not yet completed

limitations: Configured rule count does not mean 17 individually verified packet-flow tests.
Administrative access hardening is an upcoming security change.

name: NOVA-DC01
summary: Helps company computers find the domain and authenticate employees.

details.label: Operating system
details.value: Windows Server 2025 Standard

details.label: Services
details.value: Active Directory Domain Services, DNS, Kerberos, LDAP

details.label: Network
details.value: INFRA / VLAN 20

details.label: Recovery
details.value: System State backup configured; 3 recovery versions at last check

details.label: Partner
details.value: NOVA-DC02, a second writable Domain Controller

limitations: Complete System State restoration has not been demonstrated.
Linking a policy is not proof of client-side application.

name: NOVA-DC02
summary: Continues serving directory and DNS requests when DC01 is unavailable.

details.label: Operating system
details.value: Windows Server 2025 Standard

details.label: Directory
details.value: Writable Domain Controller and Global Catalog

details.label: Network
details.value: INFRA / VLAN 20

details.label: Resilience test
details.value: Client selected DC02 during controlled DC01 outage

limitations: A successful directory failover is not a whole-server restore.

name: NOVA-FILES01
summary: Holds departmental documents, controls who may open them and supports file recovery.

details.label: Operating system
details.value: Windows Server 2025 Standard

details.label: Company folders
details.value: Five departmental shares under a DFS namespace

details.label: Access
details.value: SMB share and NTFS folder permissions both matter

details.label: Backups
details.value: Windows Backup D: to B:, 20 recovery versions at last check

details.label: Tested recovery
details.value: Deleted file restored with the same SHA-256 fingerprint

limitations: Windows backup destination is within the nested lab failure domain.
One tested Shadow Copy recovery does not validate all stored copies.

name: NOVA-CLIENT
summary: A Windows workstation used to verify sign-in, policies, shared files and blocked management access.

details.label: Platform
details.value: Windows client guest; Proxmox VM 103 named nova-client01

details.label: Network
details.value: CLIENT / VLAN 40

details.label: Tests
details.value: Directory discovery, Group Policy, shared-file access and network isolation

limitations: Its Proxmox VM name and Windows computer name differ; they are the same guest.
